name: Shotgun Surgery
description: A change to one part of the system requires many small changes to many different classes. This occurs when a single responsibility has been split across multiple classes.

refactoringTechniques.name: Move Method
refactoringTechniques.description: Consolidate related behaviors that are spread across multiple classes into a single class.

refactoringTechniques.name: Move Field
refactoringTechniques.description: Relocate data that's accessed by multiple classes to a centralized location.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Class
refactoringTechniques.description: Create a new class that encapsulates the common behavior currently spread across multiple classes.

refactoringTechniques.name: Inline Class
refactoringTechniques.description: Merge classes that have been broken apart unnecessarily.
